name: Liran Tal personal website and blog
description: AI security research, open-source projects, books, talks, and articles on AI agents, MCP, Node.js, and software supply-chain security.
whenToUse: Find Liran Tal's published writing on AI and agent security, MCP, Node.js security, and software supply chains.
Browse Liran Tal's open-source projects, research, books, or conference talks.
Retrieve public post metadata or article text for research and citation.

capabilities.description: Retrieve all published blog post metadata, sorted newest first. Filter titles, descriptions, categories, and tags locally.
Retrieve up to 50 published posts per page. Start at cursor 0, follow nextCursor at /api/posts/cursor/{cursor}.json, and stop when nextCursor is null.
Fetch the markdownUrl returned by a post metadata record to read the complete article.
Read recent published articles from the RSS feed.

notes: The posts endpoint returns metadata; each item includes a Markdown URL for its full article.
There is no dedicated MCP server or write API.
